explication: CatBoost is a gradient-boosted decision-tree machine-learning product. Its principal visible workflow is a user invoking the CLI to fit a model, then use CLI modes to calculate predictions or inspect and evaluate the model. The README also identifies categorical and numerical feature support, GPU training, feature-importance tools, and distributed training as product capabilities. The supplied tree is selective and the excerpts do not expose the core CPU training implementation, so links into unsampled internals are omitted; the GPU and language-binding nodes reflect available paths, not a complete runtime trace.
